description: This file defines the RedirectMiddleware class for handling HTTP redirection logic within the GuzzleHttp client library. It manages redirect responses, controls redirect limits, modifies requests during redirection, and tracks redirect history.

classes.name: GuzzleHttp\RedirectMiddleware
classes.description: Implements middleware for handling HTTP redirect responses, managing redirect limits, request modifications, and redirect history tracking.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that takes the next handler callable in the middleware chain.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware, processes redirection logic if enabled, and forwards the request.

methods.name: checkRedirect
methods.description: Checks if the response is a redirect, manages redirect limits, and prepares the next redirect request.

methods.name: withTracking
methods.description: Enables tracking of redirect history by annotating responses with history headers.

methods.name: guardMax
methods.description: Ensures the number of redirects does not exceed the configured maximum.

methods.name: modifyRequest
methods.description: Modifies the outgoing request based on redirect response, including URL adjustments and header management.

methods.name: redirectUri
methods.description: Calculates the redirect URI from the Location header, ensuring protocol compliance.
